entries.sentence: We ran to catch the bus.
entries.chinese: catch = 赶上；我们跑着去赶公交车。

entries.sentence: We celebrated her birthday at home.
entries.chinese: celebrate = 庆祝；我们在家庆祝了她的生日。

entries.sentence: He was caught cheating in the exam.
entries.chinese: cheat = 作弊；他考试作弊时被发现了。

entries.sentence: You can choose any seat.
entries.chinese: choose = 选择；你可以任选一个座位。

entries.sentence: The audience clapped loudly.
entries.chinese: clap = 鼓掌；观众热烈鼓掌。

entries.sentence: We climbed the hill before lunch.
entries.chinese: climb = 攀登；我们午饭前爬上了山。

entries.sentence: I collected the tickets from the office.
entries.chinese: collect = 领取；我从办公室领了票。

entries.sentence: Please come home before dark.
entries.chinese: come = 来；请在天黑前回家。

entries.sentence: Come on, or we will miss the train.
entries.chinese: come on = 快点；快点，否则我们会错过火车。

entries.sentence: We usually communicate by email.
entries.chinese: communicate = 沟通；我们通常通过电子邮件沟通。

entries.sentence: Compare the prices before you buy.
entries.chinese: compare = 比较；购买前比较一下价格。

entries.sentence: Twenty runners competed in the race.
entries.chinese: compete = 参加比赛；二十名跑步者参加了比赛。

entries.sentence: She complained about the poor service.
entries.chinese: complain = 抱怨；她抱怨服务太差。

entries.sentence: Please complete this form.
entries.chinese: complete = 填写完；请填写完这张表格。

entries.sentence: I cannot concentrate with the television on.
entries.chinese: concentrate = 集中注意力；开着电视我无法集中注意力。

entries.sentence: Connect the printer to your laptop.
entries.chinese: connect = 连接；把打印机连接到笔记本电脑。

entries.sentence: We are considering your offer.
entries.chinese: consider = 考虑；我们正在考虑你的提议。

entries.sentence: The course consists of six lessons.
entries.chinese: consist = 由...组成；这门课程由六节课组成。

entries.sentence: This cake contains nuts.
entries.chinese: contain = 含有；这个蛋糕含有坚果。

entries.sentence: We continued our journey after lunch.
entries.chinese: continue = 继续；午饭后我们继续旅程。

entries.sentence: She convinced me to join the club.
entries.chinese: convince = 说服；她说服我加入了俱乐部。

entries.sentence: The class created a poster.
entries.chinese: create = 创作；全班制作了一张海报。

entries.sentence: She dealt with the problem calmly.
entries.chinese: deal = 处理；她冷静地处理了问题。

entries.sentence: We decided to walk home.
entries.chinese: decide = 决定；我们决定步行回家。

entries.sentence: The judge declared Mia the winner.
entries.chinese: declare = 宣布；裁判宣布米娅获胜。

entries.sentence: We decorated the room with balloons.
entries.chinese: decorate = 装饰；我们用气球装饰了房间。

entries.sentence: The goalkeeper defended the goal well.
entries.chinese: defend = 防守；守门员很好地守住了球门。

entries.sentence: I deleted the message by mistake.
entries.chinese: delete = 删除；我误删了那条消息。

entries.sentence: They will deliver the sofa tomorrow.
entries.chinese: deliver = 运送；他们明天会送来沙发。

entries.sentence: The train departs at noon.
entries.chinese: depart = 出发；火车中午出发。

entries.sentence: Our plans depend on the weather.
entries.chinese: depend = 取决于；我们的计划取决于天气。

entries.sentence: You deserve a rest after that long walk.
entries.chinese: deserve = 应得；走了那么久，你应该休息一下。

entries.sentence: The fire destroyed the old building.
entries.chinese: destroy = 毁坏；大火烧毁了那栋旧楼。

entries.sentence: Reading can develop your vocabulary.
entries.chinese: develop = 发展；阅读可以扩大你的词汇量。

entries.sentence: Dial this number in an emergency.
entries.chinese: dial = 拨号；紧急情况下拨打这个号码。

entries.sentence: The plant died because it had no water.
entries.chinese: die = 死亡；这株植物因为缺水死了。

entries.sentence: The dog dug a hole in the garden.
entries.chinese: dig = 挖；狗在花园里挖了一个洞。

entries.sentence: We disagreed about the best route.
entries.chinese: disagree = 不同意；我们对最佳路线意见不一。

entries.sentence: The sun disappeared behind a cloud.
entries.chinese: disappear = 消失；太阳消失在云后。

entries.sentence: The result disappointed the fans.
entries.chinese: disappoint = 使失望；结果让球迷们失望。

entries.sentence: We discovered a quiet beach.
entries.chinese: discover = 发现；我们发现了一处安静的海滩。

entries.sentence: I dislike travelling in crowded buses.
entries.chinese: dislike = 不喜欢；我不喜欢乘坐拥挤的公交车。

entries.sentence: Please do not disturb the other guests.
entries.chinese: disturb = 打扰；请不要打扰其他客人。

entries.sentence: He dived into the pool.
entries.chinese: dive = 跳水；他跳进了游泳池。

entries.sentence: Divide the cake into eight pieces.
entries.chinese: divide = 分开；把蛋糕分成八块。

entries.sentence: They dragged the heavy box across the floor.
entries.chinese: drag = 拖；他们把沉重的箱子拖过地板。

entries.sentence: Be careful not to drop the glass.
entries.chinese: drop = 使掉落；小心别把玻璃杯掉在地上。

entries.sentence: She earns money by teaching music.
entries.chinese: earn = 赚取；她通过教音乐赚钱。

entries.sentence: We ate breakfast on the balcony.
entries.chinese: eat = 吃；我们在阳台上吃了早餐。

entries.sentence: The hotel employs twelve local people.
entries.chinese: employ = 雇用；这家酒店雇用了十二名当地人。
